# awscc_mgn_connector (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::MGN::Connector



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the connector.
- `connector_id` (String) The unique identifier of the connector.
- `name` (String) The name of the connector.
- `ssm_command_config` (Attributes) SSM command configuration for the connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssm_command_config))
- `ssm_instance_id` (String) The SSM instance ID associated with this connector.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to assign to the connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--ssm_command_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssm_command_config`

Read-Only:

- `cloudwatch_log_group_name` (String) The CloudWatch Logs group name for SSM command output.
- `cloudwatch_output_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SSM command output is sent to CloudWatch Logs.
- `output_s3_bucket_name` (String) The S3 bucket name for SSM command output.
- `s3_output_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SSM command output is stored in S3.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
